Moreover, the incorporation of a best price-quality ratio awards mechanism will incentivize suppliers to provide the best value for money, further enhancing the overall value for the client. I am 80% confident in this recommendation, and I strongly advise that this approach be followed to maximize the budget utilization and minimize exposure to high-risk contracts.
